value: spore germination responds to light: 24 h of red light followed by white light raised the germination rate
method: spores cultured at 24 C under white light (8.7 W m-2) and red light (4.8 W m-2) for different treatment periods; germination scored on day 7
conditions: laboratory culture; the paper is a sulphite study and reports no dark-only control in its text, though its Table 4 lists a dark treatment period, so this shows light enhances germination, not that light is required

source.title: Effect of sulphite on spore germination and rhizoid development in the tropical fern Lygodium japonicum (Filicales: Lygodiaceae)
